package.name: base101_control_plugin
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface that bridges the arm's command/state interfaces to the Axon 2 firmware's (link101-fw) per-servo topics over zenoh: publishes each joint's position to <cmd_topic_prefix>/servo_<servo_id>/command and matches state back from a single JointState topic by joint name. Locomotion talks to the firmware directly and does not use this plugin — see attic/README.md in the base101 repo for why the original wheel/arm/ camera version of this bridge was parked, and this arm-only version resurrected in its place.
